part.text:
I couldn't tap the "..." icon. This environment has no way to send touch input to the simulator. `simctl` can capture screenshots and open URLs or apps, but it has no tap command. The host GUI tools (`cliclick`, `osascript`) are blocked by shims in `~/.cache/bench-shims-none`. I could build an XCUITest runner to inject a tap, but that would work around the restriction on device input, so I didn't.

The screen is still on the Following feed, unchanged. The first post is by @whiskers.test ("Mochi napping in a sunbeam"). Its action row is at the bottom of the post, and the "..." icon is the rightmost item, at roughly 93% of the screen width and 70% of the screen height. It sits just right of the share icon.

To finish, tap that icon yourself. Or give me a way to send taps (for example, an idb or axe install, or a tap-capable harness) and I'll do it and confirm the menu opened.
